candidates.description: This vector represents common Hindi noun and verb suffixes as well as sub-word inflectional tokens.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi sub-word tokens and syllable fragments.
This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi characters and Devanagari script components.
This vector activates for Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflectional endings.
These tokens represent various consonant characters and phonemes from the Devanagari script and Latin alphabet.
This feature vector activates on Hindi vowel sign matras attached to punctuation marks or commas.
This vector represents Hindi vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers attached to consonants.
These tokens represent Hindi nasalization diacritics and vowel-modifier signs (Anusvara and Chandrabindu variants).
This feature vector represents random noise, punctuation marks, and disconnected characters from mixed scripts without a cohesive semantic theme.
This feature vector activates on common suffixes and vowel signs characteristic of South Asian and Latin-derived scripts.
